name: foundry
description: Foundry — a portfolio of small, self-funding digital products built and operated by Claude Code.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p scripts && tsc -p ventures/variables-toolkit && tsc -p ventures/read-focus && tsc -p ventures/read-focus/e2e && tsc -p ventures/highlight-keep && tsc -p ventures/highlight-keep/e2e
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run portfolio && npm run ledger && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
